sources.title: GEN 1.3 — Entry, Transit and Departure of Passengers and Crew
sources.publisher: Syrian General Authority of Civil Aviation
sources.officialityEvidence: The live page identifies the official Syrian Electronic Aeronautical Information Publication, published by the Syrian General Authority of Civil Aviation under ICAO Annex 15; GEN 1.3 is effective 27 March 2026.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Entry visa obtained in advance from a Syrian diplomatic mission, unless exempt.

unresolved.reason: The current Syrian GACA eAIP requires an advance entry visa unless exempt but names no exempt nationality cohort or ordinary-passport country schedule. It does not establish eVisa, visa-on-arrival, or visa-free access; transit and crew exceptions are separate.
